newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 5.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Thursday:
* Staples Inc to buy Office Depot Inc in stock swap worth $3.4 billion.
* Tighter labour market widens inflation fears.
* U.S. prosecutors charge five brokers for small firms of taking bribes from a stock promoter.
* America Online Inc blocks electronic mail aimed at subscribers.
* Campbell Soup Co profits rise with revamping expected.
* Philadelphia Stock Exchange investigates its chairman for investing in a small company that later won a major contract with the bourse.
* Dreyfus Corp plans to launch service aimed at small investors.
* General Motors Corp sales fell last month.
* President Bill Clinton will soon appoint a federal panel to study the health care industry.
* Construction spending in July fell 1.4 percent.
* Manufactured Home Communities Inc launches bid for Chateau Properties Inc.
* Dow Jones Industrial Average rises 8.51 percent to close at 5,656.90.
* Times Mirror Co is looking for a buyer for Harry N. Abrams unit.
* Oil prices fall on Iraqi withdrawal.
* Deutsche Bank says the cost of bailing out three funds managed by its Morgan Grenfell unit is unclear.
